label: EchoLife HG8145V5 GPON ONT
description: GPON routing-type home gateway ONT (ITU-T G.984, Class B+, 2.488 Gbit/s down / 1.244 Gbit/s up) with four GE LAN ports, one POTS port and dual-band Wi-Fi 5 (2x2 802.11n 2.4 GHz at 300 Mbit/s plus 2x2 802.11ac 5 GHz at 867 Mbit/s); the 4GE+WiFi5 SKU ships with an SC/UPC optical adapter (SC/APC orderable in some regions).
